_: spanish-ids.json — the number in each Spanish card's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <headword> (a sounds-deck row's key) → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. Seeded from the decks as shipped on 2026-11-16 by spanish-order.js --seed-ids. Never delete or renumber a row: the Update press merges a reader's progress by id. A new note takes the next free number; a note the record removes moves to _retired, so its number is never dealt again. spanish-fix.js APPLIES this file (a rebuilt deck is renumbered back to it) and --check asserts every deck agrees with it.
